definitions.gloss: mandatory vehicle inspection; periodic car inspection
definitions.explanation: The legally required periodic safety inspection that all registered vehicles in Japan must undergo. New cars must pass their first inspection after three years, then every two years thereafter.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{車検|しゃけん}を{通|とお}さなければならない。
examples.english: I have to get my car inspected next month.

examples.japanese: {車検|しゃけん}の{費用|ひよう}が{思|おも}ったより{高|たか}くて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised that the vehicle inspection cost more than I expected.

notes: Short for {自動車検査登録制度|じどうしゃけんさとうろくせいど}. In Japan, {車検|しゃけん} is mandatory and quite expensive, often costing over 100,000 yen including taxes and fees. Common collocations: {車検|しゃけん}を{通|とお}す (to pass inspection), {車検|しゃけん}が{切|き}れる (inspection expires), {車検|しゃけん}に{出|だ}す (to take in for inspection), {車検|しゃけん}{費用|ひよう} (inspection cost). Driving with an expired {車検|しゃけん} is illegal.
